report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate a root cause. Gateway metrics show low error rate (0.0014), p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters; logs show a 200/ok request. Only one trace span shows an ERROR on gateway->order (935ms), which is a single sample and not enough to bound a cause. No order/inventory/payment/postgresql telemetry is available. Handing off for downstream evidence.
